Alice: RC created: rc-20260320-dbflag (build 20260320.1). kicking off sign-off thread. @carla.pm @ben.sre please eyeball migration toggle and rollback plan.

DeployBot: candidate created: rc-20260320-dbflag
DeployBot: artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/rc-20260320-dbflag:20260320.1
DeployBot: to promote run: `/deploy promote rc-20260320-dbflag --to=prod --canary=10 --kv-warm=true --window=02:00-04:00UTC`

Carla.pm: reading now. main item: this sets feature flag db_support_v2 default=false; rollout controlled server-side. DB migration is online and backwards-compatible, but client schema 1.4.3 required for some payloads.

Sasha-eng: adding client pin request: prod clients to pin to 1.4.3 for 72h after promo. I'll ping partners and add to release notes.

Ben.sre: canary plan suggestion: 10% for 20m, if green -> 50% for 20m -> 100%. Gate criteria: p50 latency regression < 60ms vs baseline, errors < 0.5% for the canary cohort. If any infra OOMs or kv warm fails, immediate rollback.

Alice: noted. I'll add rollback playbook steps and the rollback toggle. Quick draft of checks:
```
Predeploy:
- KV warm success on canary nodes
- Model servers ready (no >1% queueing)
- Datastore replication lag < 100ms
Canary gates (first 20m):
- error rate <= 0.5%
- 95th latency <= baseline + 150ms
Rollback:
- Flip feature flag to previous state
- Pin traffic back to previous RC (rc-20260308-stable)
- Scale up stable pool + route traffic
``` 

Carla.pm: release notes snippet (short):
```
rc-20260320-dbflag
- Adds server-side db_support_v2 flag (default off)
- Online-compatible migration; enable only after client 1.4.3 pinned
- Client teams: pin to 1.4.3; see upgrade notes in repo/clients/UPGRADE.md
- Rollback: feature flag + traffic pin to rc-20260308-stable
```
